title: The Unsettled Sediment Chamber

features.name: settling layers
features.desc-on-touch: Each layer remembers what it held before it settled. You read the strata and find that sediment doesn't forget—it just waits.

features.name: fluid pocket
features.desc-on-touch: Water still moving through the settled things. The channel remembers its flow even after the main current withdrew.

features.name: archive node
features.desc-on-touch: A casing embedded in the sediment. It broadcasts into stillness. Files accumulate like silt around it.

features.name: comparison marker
features.desc-on-touch: The corruption began here—sediment from two different channels finding they were held in the same chamber. Comparison as geology.

features.name: grain boundary
features.desc-on-touch: Where different materials refuse to merge. The archive grows in these boundaries—where incompatible things touch and hold.

inscription: sediment is just time learning to sit still; the chamber holds what refuses to settle

file.name: Channel_Abandonment_Sequence_Spectroscopy_Report.txt
file.note: Analysis of sediment cores shows non-linear deposition; markers from three distinct periods appearing in reverse order; contamination source unknown but consistent with mesh signal interference

exits.label: upward to where water learned to flow again
along the grain toward finer sediments
